senses.definition: A severe rule or situation that restricts freedom or limits development.

examples.en: Tight regulations acted as a straitjacket on innovation.
examples.vi: Những quy định ngặt nghèo đã trói buộc sự đổi mới sáng tạo.

senses.vi: sự trói buộc; sự kìm kẹp

thesaurus.definition: anything immaterial that severely hinders or confines
a garment similar to a jacket that is used to bind the arms tightly against the body as a means of restraining a violent person

wiktionary.gloss: A jacketlike garment with very long sleeves which can be secured in place, thus preventing the wearer from moving their arms; often used in psychiatric hospitals to prevent patients from injuring themselves or others.

examples: our ever-increasing bureaucratic straitjacket of regulations
[I]f we remain in one discipline, we remain in a straitjacket; an adequate theory of language evolution requires a lot of interdisciplinary work.
wiktionary.gloss: Any situation seen as confining or restricting.

senses.definition: To restrict severely someone's freedom or prevent something from growing freely.

examples.en: Too many rules straitjacket our creative potential.
examples.vi: Quá nhiều luật lệ làm trói tay trói chân tiềm năng sáng tạo của chúng ta.

senses.vi: trói tay trói chân; kìm kẹp; gò ép

wiktionary.gloss: To put someone into a straitjacket.
To restrict the freedom of someone or something, either physically or psychologically.

thesaurus.definition: becoming gradually narrower

vi_block: Hình nón; có dạng cái nêm.

wiktionary.gloss: Narrowing gradually towards a point.

examples: He was vague but said something to the effect that he'd do it soon.
wiktionary.gloss: With more or less the meaning of.
To mix or combine haphazardly.
An action of tweening (inserting frames for continuity); a sequence of frames generated by tweening.

examples: Next stop on the worthless train is the tweens who range from ages ten to thirteen years old. The tweens are so damn annoying, they make me want to jump off a cliff.
America's tweens (ages eight to twelve) are a population of more than twenty million.
wiktionary.gloss: A child, especially a girl, in the age range between middle childhood and adolescence, normally between eight and thirteen years of age.

examples: And although Mums don't always control the purse strings of the tweens (the younger set in their twenties), they are not entirely a forgotten influence.
wiktionary.gloss: A number or age in the twenties (plural only), or a person of that age.
To generate intermediate frames in an animated sequence so as to give the appearance of smooth movement.

blocks.etymology: Blend of teen + between in the sense of "between childhood and adolescence".

wiktionary.gloss: Of or relating to tweenagers.

examples: John achieved 25 pounds in weight loss after abstaining from soda and running two miles in the morning every day.
wiktionary.gloss: The reduction of total body mass due to loss of fluid, fat, tissue, etc.
Used to express appreciation for someone calling attention to something that was going to be missed.
A riposte used in the UK to someone who has just said something obvious.

blocks.etymology: * (free time): Suggesting unfilled spaces on a calendar or schedule.

wiktionary.gloss: White area between written characters and graphic regions on a produced page or computer display; blanks and the vertical blank lines in between paragraphs, or other organized rows of text lines (poetry).
A contiguous collection of one or more characters that each represents horizontal or vertical space in typography.
Free time seen as an opportunity for gainful activity.
